purpose: Document first-party local registry/map evidence and bounded anonymous geometry access review.
summary: Official Bo'ai County and Henan/Jiaozuo Tianditu map evidence was found, but no anonymous, city-bounded parcel identity plus geometry response was verified. The packet is complete for this attempt and runtime readiness remains held.
queryOutcomes: English and Chinese first-party discovery queries are recorded in city-9334-bo-ai.json. They found the official local county portal and provincial/city public map viewer, but no usable open parcel feature service.
requestOutcomes: The Bo'ai government homepage returned 403; Henan and Jiaozuo Tianditu pages and viewer scripts returned 200; two legacy viewer-linked routes returned 404. Viewer JavaScript showed basemap/POI map functions but no parcel schema or geometry endpoint. No credentials, private token, unsafe field, CAPTCHA or TLS exception was used.
scopeLimits: Exact WUP point [35.1849514073411, 113.014882171013] was preserved in latitude/longitude order; no coordinate shift or exact-point inference was made.
No city boundary or complete Bo'ai cadastral coverage was established for an open geometry service.
No parcel geometry or raw source-specific attribute set was retained.
General provincial map APIs and a map-centering control are not treated as proof of a qualified parcel adapter.
No owner, address, titleholder, contact, tax/account, registration-detail or personal fields were requested or retained.
safeFieldAllowlist: stable native parcel identifier only, if independently confirmed
source layer and public service metadata
excludedFields: tax/account/registration details beyond a safe native parcel ID
nativeIdentityPolicy: No native parcel identity was observed; no synthetic identity was created. Any future GeoJSON sample must contain exactly one independently confirmed stable native identity in properties, with source mapping documented here.
serialReviewerQualification: not qualified; independent serial review still required
uncertainty: Local government custody and official public map routes are evidenced, but anonymous parcel access, city scope, schema, CRS, native identity and geometry remain unknown. HTTP errors and absence of a discovered route are not evidence of citywide cadastral absence.
